source.description:
## PROBLEM

Service skills have no standard place to record runtime-critical deps, fragile deps, canonical post-bump tests, and post-deploy watch signals. Without it, the dependency capability cannot look up service-specific impact and must reason in the abstract (spec §12). This task adds the standard section and seeds it where it matters.

## SUCCESS

A documented `## Dependency Surface` section template is part of the service-skill convention, and the most critical service skills in the ecosystem have a seeded section. The dependency skill/inspector can look up tests, watch signals, and failure modes per service.

## SCOPE

xtrm-tools service-skill conventions + seeding. Adds the section schema (Package Managers & Lockfiles / Runtime-Critical / Build-Test-CI / GitHub Actions / Container-Base Image / Known Fragile / Historical Migration Notes / Canonical Tests After Dep Updates / Post-Deploy Watch Signals / Missing Signals) per spec §12. Librarian/service-skills-sync proposes updates when drift is found. Lower priority than B/C1/D1.

## NON_GOALS

- No backfilling every service skill — seed the critical ones only; rest via drift-driven proposals.
- No changes to deployer/SRE specialists.
- No automated test generation.

## CONSTRAINTS

- Section must be proposal-driven: the dependency skill proposes a patch/follow-up when it finds drift, not in-place indiscriminate edits (spec §12).
- Keep sections accurate and dated; avoid stale migration notes.
- Follow existing service-skill authoring conventions.

## VALIDATION

- [ ] Section template documented in the service-skill convention
- [ ] At least the top critical service skills seeded
- [ ] service-skills-sync/librarian can propose Dependency Surface updates from a dependency case
- [ ] Smoke: a bump touching a seeded service reads tests + watch signals from the section

## OUTPUT

Section template + seeded skills + a sample proposal from a dependency case.

## REFERENCES

- `~/dev/xtrm/docs/devops/dependencies-updating.md` §12 (service-skills integration)
- Depends on B (xtrm-r1ed7.1) for the skill that consumes the section
